Additional Benefits Verification
The healthy food and utilities benefit is a special supplemental benefit available to enrollees with a qualifying chronic
condition, who also meet plan criteria indicating they are at high risk for hospitalization and eligible for intensive care

Qualifying Clinical Conditions
Diabetes mellitus (type 1 or type 2)

3. You understand that when your coverage begins with this plan, you must get all of your medical and prescription drug

document (also known as a member contract or subscriber agreement) will be covered. Neither Medicare nor this plan
will pay for benefits or services that are not covered.
4. You understand that you can be enrolled in only one MA plan at a time – and that enrollment in this plan will

automatically end your enrollment in another MA plan (exceptions apply for MA PFFS, MA MSA plans).

CMS may use, disclose and exchange enrollment data from Medicare beneficiaries as specified in the System of
